Our story

A family remedy, carried across an ocean

Sagrado began at home. Ramon Sagrado, a Filipino native, grew up with a tea brewed from tree branches gathered in the forests of the Philippines. He carried that knowledge to the United States, wrote it down, and turned it into a repeatable method.

The method combines seven tree-branch ingredients, among them luyan-luyan (Dracontomelon dao), and simmers them into a deep amber tea. The same blend can be prepared as an ointment for the skin. In 2021 the method was granted a United States patent.

The identity follows the same roots: botanical illustration, mountain sunrises and apothecary glass, finished with a modern hand.

The ritual

From forest to cup

Four steps, the same way the family has always made it. Keep scrolling to follow the branch.

1

Gathered

Seven kinds of tree branch are sourced from the forests of the Philippines, the same trees the recipe has always used.

2

Blended

The branches are combined in the proportions set out in the patented method, then packed as a loose blend.

3

Simmered

The blend is boiled slowly until it turns deep amber. The longer it rests, the richer the color.

4

Shared

Bottled in amber glass to pour, packed in kraft to brew at home, or prepared as a balm. Choose your format →

Good questions

        
Before you brew

        
Plain answers about what Sagrado is, how to use it, and how it ships.

      

      

        
Is Sagrado a medicine?+
No. Sagrado is a traditional botanical tea and balm. The patent protects how it is made; it is not an approval from the FDA or any health authority. If you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication or managing a condition, talk to your doctor before adding it to your routine.

        
What is in it?+
A blend of seven tree-branch ingredients sourced from the forests of the Philippines, including luyan-luyan (Dracontomelon dao). The full ingredient list is printed on every label.

        
How do I prepare the loose tea?+
Simmer the blend in water, strain, and serve warm or chilled. Each pouch carries exact measures and steeping times. The bottle is already prepared: shake and pour.

        
How does the subscription work?+
Choose Subscribe on any product to save 15%. Pick a delivery every 30, 60 or 90 days, and skip, swap or cancel from your account at any time.

        
Where do you ship?+
At launch we ship across the United States, free on orders over $60. International buyers can reach us through a regional distributor; see the partner program.

        
Can I sell Sagrado in my store or clinic?+
Yes. Retailers, practitioners and distributors each have their own terms. Explore the partner program.
